scenicChapters.title: Lariat Loop Scenic and Historic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 54 km this is Lariat Loop Scenic and Historic Byway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

facts.v: Lariat Loop Scenic and Historic Byway

denver-colorado-rockies-rocky-mountain-n.story: From Aurora it runs 772 km to Brighton; allow about 16 h 27 of riding. The stops in between: Berthoud, near Nederland and Sheridan. The climbs: Near Berthoud, on the way back, near Evergreen, Rocky Mountain National Park Trail and Near Lyons, on the way back. It tops out at about 3,200 m.

scenicChapters.title: Belfort met Lakenhal → Beffroi de l’Hôtel de Ville de Comines
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 17 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

On the way it passes Beffroi de l’Hôtel de Ville de Comines, Beffroi de l’Hôtel de Ville d’Armentières, Beffroi de l’Hôtel de Ville de Loos and Hôtel de ville. It crosses from Belgium into France - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.

scenicChapters.title: Estrada da Graciosa
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 29 km this is Estrada da Graciosa, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-serras-do-cordeiro-ilha-do-mel-ec.story: From Quatro Barras it runs 216 km to Quatro Barras; allow about 3 h 43 of riding. The stops in between: Zone & State Park Pau Oco Turistical Prese, Guaraguacu Ecological Station, Ilha do Mel Ecological Station and back through Guaraguacu Ecological Station. The line favours views over speed.
